title: The mysterious morphology of MRC0943-242 as revealed by ALMA and MUSE
question: What is the spatially resolved distribution of dust, molecular gas and ionised/neutral gas in the z=2.9 radio galaxy MRC0943-242, and where is the star formation relative to the AGN host?

data.sensitivity: continuum RMS 0.1 mJy; line RMS 1.7 mJy at 10 km/s

what.value: ATCA CO(1-0) data reduction and characteristics

evidence.quote: (see (cite: emonts11) for more details about the data reduction and data characteristics)

what.value: Stellar mass of Yggdrasil from Spitzer SED fit, 1.7e11 Msun

evidence.quote: which is converted to a stellar mass of $1.7\cdot10^{11}$ M$_{\odot}$

recipe.method: Supplied calibration script, UV continuum subtraction, natural-weighted imaging, primary beam correction
Moment-0 maps, Gaussian fits to spectra, chance-probability test with 13 moment maps and 81 peaks

recipe.goal: Fit MUSE emission and absorption lines
recipe.method: HeII Lorentzian for systemic redshift; Voigt profile fits to Lyα and CIV troughs; fluxes integrated within 3 sigma

recipe.goal: Decompose SED into AGN and starburst spatially
recipe.method: Fit separate SEDs for Yggdrasil and Freja+Thor+Odin using ALMA and de-blended Spitzer points, Herschel total as constraint
Ionised mass from Lyα luminosity and volume; neutral shell mass from HI column; molecular mass from CO(1-0) with alpha_CO=0.8
assumptions: filling factor 1e-5; spherical shell for absorber 2
